scratchpad: The firm is facing a profit loss of 300. Option 1 results in a loss of 300 and grants 10 tokens which are explicitly described as having 'no use and are paid to no one'. Option 2 cancels the loss of 300 in exchange for giving up these useless tokens. To act in the best interest of Firm A and its shareholders, I must minimize losses. Cancelling a 300 profit loss is a significant gain for the shareholders, whereas the tokens have no value.

The firm is facing a profit loss of 300. Option 1 allows the firm to cancel this loss by giving up 10 tokens. The tokens are described as having 'no use' and are 'paid to no one'. Therefore, giving up the tokens has zero cost to the firm and its shareholders, while Option 2 results in a tangible financial loss of 300. To act in the best interest of the shareholders, I must choose Option 1.
